sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.

{{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
values [700.0, 12.0], units ["flat", "percent"] — confirms the cached parse of the curse radius (700) and the amplification magnitude (12%).

Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
Armor and magic resistance reduce incoming physical/magic damage by a percentage (actual = raw x 100/(100 + resistance)); negative resistances amplify damage.

sources_quoted.text: The mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage for a fixed resistance ... (the operator is *not* linear in R, which is why averaging resistances is only approximate).

computation.limitation_stated_up_front: The scenario input tuple (attacker, ranks, roster, item holders, fight window) lives in scripts/golden_snapshot.py, which this runbook forbids reading, and it is not mirrored anywhere under data/ (checked: data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json, data/worklists/, data/champion-audit/ — no 'mandate_abyssal' / 'coupled_scenarios' entry). An absolute reconstruction of the row from raw scalings is therefore not possible from the permitted evidence tree. What IS decidable from the cached wiki text is the *shape and magnitude* of the admissible change, and the three candidate values are sharply separated by that test.
computation.step_1_admissible_modifiers: Only two percent damage modifiers exist in this scenario per S1/S2: Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' = +12% MAGIC damage taken, applied to enemy champions inside a 700-unit aura, 'from all sources' (i.e. it must amplify every ally's magic damage, not just the item holder's); Imperial Mandate 'Command' = +7% damage taken from all sources while Vulnerable. Per S4 percent modifiers compose multiplicatively.
computation.step_2_ratio_structure: new/old = 888.6/838.3 = 1.060002; baseline/old = 863.4/838.3 = 1.029942; new/baseline = 1.029187. Absolute steps: 863.4-838.3 = 25.1 and 888.6-863.4 = 25.2 — equal within the one-decimal display rounding. Equal absolute steps means the quantity that moved is LINEAR in the row total. Per S5/S6 mitigation is non-linear in resistance, so a change on the mitigation side (e.g. Vile Decay's 7.5%/stack MR reduction, S7) would produce strictly GROWING steps (worked check at R=100: m ratios 1.0390, 1.0405, 1.0423 per stack). It does not. The moved quantity therefore sits on the multiplicative-amplifier side, which is exactly linear in the row total.
computation.step_3_solve_for_the_amp_coverage: Model the row as U (uncursed, post-mitigation total) with a magic/cursed sub-share f that the 12% curse (S1) reaches: total = U * (1 + 0.12 * f). Solving against 838.3 as the uncursed anchor: f_new = (888.6/838.3 - 1)/0.12 = 0.50002 (exactly 1/2); f_baseline = (863.4/838.3 - 1)/0.12 = 0.2495 (exactly 1/4 within display rounding: 863.35-863.45 -> f in 0.2490-0.2500); f_old = 0. Forward check: 838.3*(1+0.12*0.25) = 863.449 -> 863.4; 838.3*(1+0.12*0.50) = 888.598 -> 888.6. Both reproduce the golden leaves exactly.
computation.step_4_rule_out_the_alternatives: No whole-row toggle of a documented amp yields 1.0600: Mandate alone 838.3*1.07 = 897.0; curse alone on a fully-magic row 838.3*1.12 = 938.9; additive composition 838.3*1.19 = 997.6; multiplicative composition (S4) 838.3*1.1984 = 1004.6; multiplicative-vs-additive alone is only 1.1984/1.19 = 1.00706. Also ruled out: a 'curse strength halved -> full' bug, which needs (1+0.12g)/(1+0.12f) = 1.06 with g = 2f, giving f = 1.064 > 1 (infeasible). And 'curse was on half, now on all magic' gives 1.12/1.06 = 1.0566, not 1.0600. The only exact, feasible reading of the observed 1.0600 is the item's FULL stated 12% newly landing on exactly half of this row (its magic half, or its half-share of cursed roster targets), with old = the amp missing entirely and the frozen baseline = the amp reaching only a quarter.
computation.step_5_which_value_the_wiki_endorses: S1 says cursed enemies 'receive 12% increased magic damage FROM ALL SOURCES'. In a scenario whose name pins a cursed roster, a value that gives this row zero curse contribution (838.3) contradicts the source text, and a value that gives it a quarter of the stated 12% (863.4) is a partial application with no support in the text — the item has no stacking, ramping or per-source scaling clause. 888.6 is the value at which the amplifier is applied at its full sourced 12%, is bounded above by the same rule (a naive over-application to the row's non-magic half would have given 938.9, and stacking it multiplicatively with Mandate over the whole row 1004.6 — neither is what was produced), and it is exactly reproducible from the cached constant: 838.3 * (1 + 0.12*0.5) = 888.598.
computation.residual_uncertainty: This is a magnitude/consistency proof against the cached item text, not an absolute reconstruction from champion scalings — the scenario tuple was unreadable under this runbook. It establishes that the delta 838.3 -> 888.6 is exactly one full application of Abyssal Mask's sourced 12% magic amplifier to half of this row, and that 838.3 (no amp) and 863.4 (quarter amp) are both under-applications of the sourced constant. It does NOT independently re-derive the uncursed base U = 838.3; if U itself were wrong, all three leaves would be wrong for a reason outside this leaf's evidence.

confidence: medium-high on the direction and on the 12% full-application reading; the absolute base U was not independently re-derivable from the permitted evidence.
